burndown_policy.approved_strategy_rule: Approved internal-sim strategies may only continue through the next M12.47-supervised refresh and post-refresh M13/M14 recompute.
burndown_policy.mutation_rule: No parameter, registry, account-spec, broker-readiness, broker/live, or manual M12.37 once-mode mutation is allowed.
burndown_policy.pre_refresh_rule: Before fresh market evidence exists, only artifact review, shadow-spec review, and external-reference checklist work are allowed.
burndown_policy.purpose: Turn open M14 strategy evidence gaps into an ordered rescue/internal-sim work queue.
burndown_policy.rescue_rule: Weak strategies keep rescue or shadow review until first ledger, rescue 10-day A/B, and manual M14 review evidence are complete.
